newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested, compared to Friday's close, USDA said.
Trade was slow, with demand and seller interest light. Offerings current.
Steers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1225 lbs ld no sales. Heifers:Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
